presentation.label: DELAY
presentation.summary: Four tuned combs on a chord turn a hit or a noise burst into a ringing chord.
presentation.overview: A resonator insert: the track's audio excites four feedback combs whose pitches form a chord. Short decays give a metallic ring on hats and percussion; long decays make dub stabs out of single hits, and FREEZE holds the chord as a drone.
highlights: Seven voicings, from close to wide.
Decay up to 20 seconds with every note ringing for the same time.
usage: Choose RESO in FX2, set TUNE and DCAY, then push MIX up. Feed it a short hit or noise for a chord stab.

controls.name: DCAY
controls.doc: Ring time: 50 ms at 0 to 20 s at 127, the same for every note.

controls.name: BRIT
controls.doc: Damping: 127 keeps the highs; lower values make high notes die sooner.

controls.name: SPRD
controls.doc: Stereo spread of the four voices, centre to wide.

controls.name: DRIV
controls.doc: Drive into the rings; high values reach the ring clip for industrial tones.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet; 0 is an exact passthrough, 127 fully wet.

controls.name: CHRD
controls.doc: Chord the voices ring at; USER takes INT2..INT4.

controls.name: VOIC
controls.doc: Voicing: close, three inversions, drop-2, open or wide.

controls.name: FREZ
controls.doc: Freeze: closes the input and holds the rings.

limitations: FX2 only: the four rings need 8,192 words, more than an FX1 slot offers.
Not tested on hardware; the engine is verified in dsp56kEmu only.
The four rings stop short of Sidechain Compressor's key window.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Four 2,048-word rings in the FX2 instance buffer.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: Steady state, four voices, emulator instruction count, not chip cycles.

impact.conditions: Emulator only: four voices at 44.1 kHz, dsp56kEmu instruction count; no chip cycles.

cpu.rationale: Control work once per call; the sample loop is four short combs.

dsp.rationale: 236 emulator instructions per frame, under stock SPRING REV's ~314.

memory.rationale: 8,192 words of FX2 buffer for the four rings, plus 47 words of r7 state.

tests.summary: Emulator only: tuning, decay, freeze, dry path and silence pass; no hardware report yet.
gates: Worst-case cycles under parameter modulation and maximum load
Exact memory region and maximum-instance totals
Owner-reviewed real-hardware evidence with actual coverage and limitations

license.declaration: Original design and source by michaelmenesescs, MIT. Built on published techniques (feedback comb / Karplus-Strong resonators, Thiran allpass interpolation, Jot-style T60 loop gain). No Elektron firmware, routines or tables.

steps: Select an audio track, open its FX2 slot and choose RESO from the effect list.
Press YES, set TUNE and DCAY, then raise MIX.
Hold the effect key to reach page 2 for CHRD, VOIC, INT2..INT4 and FREZ.
